tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page canvas: true black in dark, Apple's #f5f5f7 grey in light. Marketing pages, the app shell, the recessed wells behind demos and code.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, the docs content panel, dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus, toasts, chart panels.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card (shadcn --card-foreground). Same value as foreground.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Surface of popovers, menus and select lists (shadcn --popover). Same value as card.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, secondary buttons, the tabs track, skeleton blocks, menu highlight.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (shadcn --secondary). Same value as muted.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary. 12.8:1 in dark, 13.8:1 in light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: System blue, the single tint, the same in both themes: the active sidebar item and text selection. The focus ring and links are the same blue family. As text, 3.6:1 on card in dark (below 4.5:1, flagged) and 4.7:1 in light. Fumadocs' neutral hover fills read muted instead.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: white, 4.7:1 on accent.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, separators, table rules, chart gridlines. Decorative (1.4:1 on card in dark, 1.3:1 in light).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of controls: inputs, textareas, select triggers, unchecked checkboxes and radios, the switch track when off. 1.8:1 on card in dark, 1.5:1 in light, below the 3:1 a control edge needs (flagged); prefers-contrast: more raises it.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: System blue focus outline (2px solid, 2px offset) and the hovered/focused input border. 4.7:1 on card in both themes; 5.8:1 on background in dark, 4.3:1 in light.

tokens.name: ring-halo
tokens.usage: The soft 3px halo around a focused input, outside its ring-coloured border. Decorative; the border carries the contrast.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on background, card and muted. 15.6:1 on card in dark, 16.8:1 in light.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text on background, card and muted: descriptions, metadata, axis labels, placeholders. 6.6:1 on card in dark, 6.0:1 in light; 5.4:1 on muted in dark, 4.9:1 in light.

tokens.name: subtle-foreground
tokens.usage: Tertiary marks only: chart axis lines, disabled icons, the empty-state glyph. Not for text (3.4:1 on card in dark, 2.6:1 in light).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Ink: near-white in dark, near-black in light. The one primary action per view, checked controls (checkbox, radio, switch) and badges. 15.6:1 on card in dark, 16.8:1 in light.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover: one step softer than primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill: the primary button label, the check glyph, the switch thumb when on. 15.5:1 on primary in dark, 16.8:1 in light.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Fill inside inputs, textareas, selects and unchecked checkboxes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modal dialogs and the mobile sidebar. Floating layers do not dim the page.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy state and positive deltas (conversion up, goal met), always beside an icon and a sign. Text on card: 8.4:1 dark, 5.1:1 light; 6.5:1 and 4.4:1 on success-soft (light is below 4.5:1, flagged).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: sampling active, quota near, tracking delayed. Always with an icon. Text on card: 8.3:1 dark, 5.2:1 light; 6.4:1 and 4.5:1 on warning-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, negative deltas, destructive actions; always with an icon or sign. Text on card: 5.0:1 dark, 5.4:1 light; 4.3:1 on danger-soft in dark (below 4.5:1, flagged), 4.5:1 in light.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind success text in alerts and toasts.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning text in alerts and toasts.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill and the tint behind danger text.

tokens.name: danger-soft-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button on hover; invalid input halo.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid danger fill (shadcn --destructive-foreground): white in both themes. 3.4:1 on danger in dark, below 4.5:1 (flagged); 5.4:1 in light.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series slot 1, the lightest step of a five-step blue ramp, the same in both themes: the headline series, e.g. Visitors or Revenue. Steps differ in lightness, so the ramp suits ordered or ranked series. Lines 2px, bars 4px-rounded ends. 9.5:1 on card in dark; 1.8:1 in light, below the 3:1 a mark needs (flagged): use it for fills there, not thin lines.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series slot 2: the comparison series, e.g. Previous period or Pageviews. 4.6:1 on card in dark, 3.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series slot 3. Assign slots in order, never cycled; a series keeps its slot when filters hide others. 3.3:1 on card in dark, 5.1:1 in light.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series slot 4. Lines and bars only; scatter and maps stop at three series. 2.6:1 on card in dark, below 3:1 (flagged); 6.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series slot 5, the darkest step. A sixth series folds into Other. 1.9:1 on card in dark, below 3:1 (flagged); 8.9:1 in light.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: The folded Other series, and the unselected bars of a highlight.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar surface; the same as background.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the sidebar. 19.3:1 on sidebar in dark, 15.5:1 in light.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: The active sidebar item: accent blue in both themes.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary. 4.7:1.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered and selected sidebar items.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-accent. 12.4:1 in dark, 15.1:1 in light.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Hairline between the sidebar and the page, and between sidebar groups. Decorative.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline inside the sidebar. 5.8:1 on sidebar in dark, 4.3:1 in light.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline text links in prose and on the landing page. 5.6:1 on card in both themes.

tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: Translucent bar material: landing nav, docs toolbar. Pair with backdrop-filter blur(var(--material-blur)) saturate(var(--material-saturate)).

tokens.name: material-thick
tokens.usage: Thicker translucent material for floating layers: popovers, menus, tooltips, toasts, mobile sidebar.

tokens.name: material-edge
tokens.usage: Highlight along the edge of a translucent material.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Quiet divider that replaces most borders between sections.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per marketing page: the hero line.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: App page titles: Overview, Journeys, Funnels, Revenue.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The headline number in a KPI card. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Tally follows each visitor from first touch to paid order.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sessions from organic search rose 12% this week.
styles.usage: Default UI text, inputs, table cells, descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, tab triggers, alert titles.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button, menu item and badge labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above section titles and KPI labels.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: URLs, UTM strings, event names, IDs in tables.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label in badges; menu padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; label to input.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Alert vertical padding; gap inside a card footer.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Popover and toast padding; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding; gap between dashboard cards.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between card groups on a dashboard.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Section padding in the app.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Section padding on marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, menu items, chart bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, popovers, tooltips, menus, toasts, tab triggers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, the sidebar highlight, tabs track, alerts, skeletons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, switches, radio dots, status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards and the docs content panel: a hairline ring with a soft drop in light, a ring alone in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles on hover: the card shadow lifted further.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, select lists, toasts and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The active tab trigger.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Filled and outline buttons at rest: a soft drop plus a faint top highlight so they sit above the surface. Ghost buttons stay flat.

tokens.name: shadow-button-hover
tokens.usage: Filled and outline buttons on hover: the button shadow lifted further.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Default spring (damping 1.0, response 0.4s, no overshoot): overlays, sheets, layout changes.

tokens.name: ease-spring-snappy
tokens.usage: Snappy spring (damping 1.0, response 0.3s): press release, toggles, small controls.

tokens.name: ease-spring-bounce
tokens.usage: Bouncy spring (damping 0.8, response 0.4s, 1.5% overshoot): momentum only.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Short colour and press feedback that must never lag the input.

tokens.name: material-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind --material.

tokens.name: material-blur-thick
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind --material-thick.

tokens.name: material-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation for both materials.

meta.note: Neutral, surface, border, sidebar, primary, ring, link and status colours, the material and shadow tokens, and the motion tokens were merged in on 2026-11-08 from the site's former Apple layer. Chart colours, type, spacing and radii are unchanged.
